cohort: 192,405 nulliparous women with term, singleton, vertex (NTSV) deliveries in New York City from 2012 to 2016
finding: The implementation of the ACOG-SMFM 2014 recommendations was associated with a decrease in the age-standardized NTSV Cesarean rate, but this decrease was only observed among non-Hispanic White women.
mod_finding: The study examined the impact of ACOG-SMFM recommendations on reducing unnecessary primary cesarean sections, finding a decrease in the overall rate but persistent disparities among different racial groups.
